messages:
marta: quick note from testing rotate in staging — a few small UX/accessibility friction points for the single-show key drawer. TL;DR: toast covers drawer on mobile, screen readers silent on copy, and empty-state is noisy with org policy. ryan (design): thanks — short bullets please so dev can run with it. :sparkles: marta: bullets: 1) move global toast or make inline confirmation so it doesn't overlap secret drawer on small screens; 2) aria-live announcement for reveal & copy/fail; 3) consider masking the key immediately after an action and a soft banner that warns it's one-time; 4) collapse org policy in empty state to a single line. devin (frontend): For (1) we can add an inline helper next to the key and shift global snack to top-right. For (2) aria-live is trivial. Implementation note: ensure focus goes to Copy button when drawer opens. ida (a11y): Strong +1 on focus management. Also: use aria-live="polite" for success and "assertive" for failures. When drawer opens, set role="dialog" with aria-modal and focus trap. Announce: "API key revealed. Copy button focused." nina (security): Reminder: plaintext must not persist in DOM or logs. If we mask after copy, ensure we remove it from DOM (not just visually hide) and clear any in-memory refs. Also confirm clipboard usage doesn't surface in analytics breadcrumbs. ryan (design): microcopy suggestion for inline messages: success -> "API key copied to clipboard." fail -> "Copy failed. Please download the key." single-show banner -> "This key will not be shown again. Store it now." devin (frontend): sample aria snippet Ill add: ```html
API key copied to clipboard.
``` We will toggle text on success/fail. Also will run an e2e that simulates clipboard rejection. ida (a11y): add keyboard shortcut guidance in the drawer (e.g., hint: Press Ctrl+C / ⌘C to copy) and ensure visible focus outlines on Copy/Download buttons. ci-bot: deploy:staging started for branch fix/key-drawer-a11y by @devin at 2024-06-01T11:30:00Z marta: thanks all. Devin please include a DOM-check unit test that asserts plaintext removed within 1s after action. Ryan will update spec copy. Nina will run quick staging audit. Ping this thread when deployed. :white_check_mark:
